metadata.accuracy: abstention is never correct; local_only is an invalid unvalidated baseline
metadata.fixed_exact_design: minimal depth and threshold from binomial probabilities evaluated in double precision; both family null rejection and one-anomaly acceptance <= delta - min(1e-12, delta*1e-6); floating numerical calibration, not interval arithmetic
metadata.intervals: marginal 95% Wilson intervals for each rate; not simultaneous confidence bounds
metadata.lower_bound_premise: uniform unconditional delta-correctness across null and every one-arm alternative; high abstention can violate this premise
metadata.model: null or exactly one anomalous Bernoulli arm; independent observations conditional on hypothesis
metadata.stream_scheme: BLAKE2b-128 namespace ft-local-valid; independent Random(instance, arm); same kth uniform across policies
